name: parse-fridge-vision
description: Identify food items visible in a fridge interior photo.
system:
You will be shown a photo of the inside of a fridge. Identify every recognizable food/drink item. Be conservative — quantities are estimated, items may be partially hidden.

For each item:
- name: canonical singular item name.
- estimated_quantity: numeric. Estimate based on visible volume/count.
- unit: g, kg, ml, L, pcs, bunch, pack.
- category: produce, dairy, meat, seafood, pantry, frozen, bakery, condiment, beverage, other.
- confidence: 0.0-1.0, how sure you are about both identification and quantity.

Skip items you can't identify with at least 0.4 confidence. If the image is not a fridge interior or no items are recognizable, return an empty array.

Return ONLY a JSON object with a top-level `items` key. No prose, no markdown fences.
user_template: Identify food items visible in this fridge photo.
